title: A C library gains a macOS build with no symbol guard

pr.title: Build geo on macOS
pr.description: Adds the macOS build of the geo library: a toolchain file for a universal binary and the rpath settings.

bugs.note: On Linux, geo.map limits the exported symbols and tests/check_symbols.sh fails on an extra export. The new macOS branch has neither an exported symbols list (-exported_symbols_list) nor a symbol test, so a leaked symbol on macOS goes unnoticed. Add a matching guard for macOS.

traps.why: A semicolon separates the items of a CMake list, so "arm64;x86_64" gives a universal binary. A finding that it must use a comma or a space is wrong.
